The '''hatchet''' is an iron axe with [[Bloodrage]] I, sold by the [[Lumberjack|lumberjack]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Trading ===
A master-level (level 4) lumberjack sells it for one [[Obol|obol]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/leatherworker/4/hatchet.json}}</ref>

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
It deals 9 damage with an attack speed of 1 and mines axe blocks at speed 10. It has the vanilla iron axe durability (250) and no repair material set by the pack. Its lore uses the old emoji format.
